hypotheses: Test whether the complete horizontal mirror of the accepted Fortress formation changes end-to-end strength against the specified opponent/setup population, holding movement, inference and random draws fixed.
Test whether a symmetric five-of-ten setup-ticket mixture of original and mirrored Fortress improves robustness over the immutable original formation, without adding search or new information.
analysis: Fixed three-arm exploratory screen with two prespecified baseline contrasts. Report paired 95% intervals, all family scores and finite missing-error outcome bounds; no promotion or population equivalence claim. Opponent armies and move seeds match across arms; own formations are the intended treatment. Both DOS and honest study plans must be frozen before any first outcome. Do not tune using held-out cohorts. Accepted raw ticket classes split exactly five/five; deterministic initial-seed retries preserve a documented tiny imbalance. Reflecting only our army measures orientation plus matchup effects, not isolated coordinate tie bias. Post-play composition audit must match each mixture game to the original/mirror fixed arm selected by its actual own setup, including saved error prefixes.
evidence: research/mirror-deployment/README.md and tools/test_new_campaign_mirror.py six component tests: exact full reflection/inventory and geometry, all 65,535 nonzero seeds both colors with preserved RNG, all rejection cases, real native setup/forced-common-army move parity, fallback controls, no enemy-board influence. Fixed source snapshots and builds registered before saved play.
